willow_thornby.name: Seed pods
willow_thornby.rule: Push the seed pods onto the soil patches. When every patch is planted, the vine gate opens.
willow_thornby.hint: A sign at the door: “Seeds only go forward. Think before you push one into a corner.”

mara_quill.name: Bakery belts
mara_quill.rule: Stepping onto a conveyor belt carries you along it until it ends. Reach the cake stand.
mara_quill.hint: The baker’s note: “The belts only carry you. They never stop you midway.”

tavish_rook.name: Dojo screens
tavish_rook.rule: Reach the back room through screen D. Each floor plate flips the screens listed on the scroll. Walking over a plate counts, and a screen you close behind you stays closed.
tavish_rook.hint: The scroll: a flips A. b flips C and D. c flips B. d flips A. e flips B and C. Open screens are pale, closed screens are solid.

coral_marlowe.name: Tide valves
coral_marlowe.rule: Sandbars can be walked at low tide. Boats can be walked at high tide. Stepping on a valve flips the tide.
coral_marlowe.hint: The harbor master’s tide chart: “Low tide at dawn. Each valve turns the tide once.”

volt_dray.name: Power the floor
volt_dray.rule: Stepping on a panel flips it and the panels touching it. Light all eighteen to open the gate. You have to walk across the panels to get through.
volt_dray.hint: A wiring diagram: a panel and its four neighbors share a circuit.

skye_corvin.name: Gale slide
skye_corvin.rule: The updrafts carry you until something stops you. Clouds stop you too. Skip over the gaps; falling sends you back to the start.
skye_corvin.hint: A pennant on the wall: “The wind does not stop until it hits something.”

sage_ilmara.name: Mirror twin
sage_ilmara.rule: Your twin moves with you, but mirrored left to right. Walls block each of you separately. Put both on a star.
sage_ilmara.hint: An engraving: “When you go left, your reflection goes right.”

cinder_valko.name: Pulse bridge
cinder_valko.rule: Even stones are safe on even steps, odd stones on odd steps. Every move is a step. A heat plate costs two steps instead of one.
cinder_valko.hint: Forge-master’s note: “The stones breathe in and out. Count your steps.”
